desc: Read N and S from stdin; build the list of 1-based indices p of all '1' characters.
Handle trivial cases: single 1 -> 0, all ones -> 0.
Compute transformed values a_k = p_k - k for each 1 (k = 1..K); they are non-decreasing so no sort needed.
Select median as a[K//2] of the a values.
Sum |a_k - median| over all k and print it.
Verified all 3 public samples pass and edge cases are sound.
